verses.1: And Jehovah angered Aioth, and he said:
verses.2: Most people who are sick will be healed by the Lord.
verses.3: And Elohim angered Jehovah, and He said:
verses.4: I also know what to say to you. My hands are tied; I can’t do anything about it.
verses.5: One thing I said, and I won’t respond to it. Two things, and I won’t accept them either.
verses.6: And Jehovah delivered Israel from the storm. He said:
verses.7: Oh, Azar-Na! As a shepherd who tends his sheep, I will ask you and inform you.
verses.8: May my nose be destroyed by the judgment that will condemn me, so that I may be saved.
verses.9: And if someone curses you, then curse them back loudly.
verses.10: Please see how high and steep it is, and how the ground and the hills are uneven.
verses.11: He will spread his wings over you, and you will see everything clearly.
verses.12: See how all those who are evil will be defeated, and how the wicked will be brought under their control.
verses.13: They are placed together in the air, with their faces facing each other.
verses.14: And I also adore you, for it will be good for you to have your right hand.
verses.15: Please see the livestock that I have made with you. They are like fresh grass that can be eaten in the morning.
verses.16: Please see his strength in his promises, and how he is strong within his own body.
verses.17: It stretched out its tail, just like a reed. Its fears were silenced.
verses.18: Their bodies were like those of insects; their limbs were like those of fish.
verses.19: He is the beginning of the ways of God; He will bring about His destruction.
verses.20: For the mountains will carry him away, and all the creatures of the wilderness will cry out there.
verses.21: Under the tent, it lies in a sealed container.
verses.22: He was cursed by Zealim; he was destroyed by the waters of Nahal.
verses.23: It will also become a river that cannot be crossed; it will not be safe to cross it, because Yarden will come down upon them.
verses.24: In his eyes, he will take us away in chains.
verses.25: She will wait for him, and with patience, she will give him what he deserves.
verses.26: Set Agmon in the apo and in the choch, so that he may live.
verses.27: May they be destroyed by you, if they speak to you in a wicked manner.
verses.28: May a covenant be made with you, so that we may serve you forever.
verses.29: Let it be woven like silk, and let it bind us to your daughters.
verses.30: His friends will recognize him; they will separate him from his companions.
verses.31: It’s filled with bubbles of foam and the sound of fish splashing.
verses.32: Put it on its proper place as a reminder of the war. Do not mix them up.
